purpose: Design (not implementation) of the permanent coach-currency refresh, from Phase 4A/4B evidence. Read-only recommendation.

cadence.principle: Recheck by programme page, prioritized by outreach-eligibility; do not recheck every coach individually.
cadence.eligible_coaches: full re-verify each pre-season (Jul-Sep, when 2026-27 staff finalize) + one mid-season spot pass (Oct-Nov); a lighter Jan-Feb pass for spring transitions.
cadence.season_sensitivity: staff churn peaks May-Aug (hiring cycle); weight fetches to late summer.

programme_page_to_many_coaches: One current staff-page fetch verifies every coach at that (institution,sport); Phase 4A measured ~7.8 coaches per fetch. Refresh is keyed on (source_domain / programme), and stamps all its coaches in one pass.
checked_at: currentness_checked_at is set per coach at each verification; a programme fetch stamps all coaches it covered, even those confirmed absent (PROVEN_STALE) — absence is a result, not a skipped check.

email_confirmation.email_confirmed_at: set when the stored address is independently observed on a current authoritative page OR proven deliverable (non-bounce/reply). Distinct from currentness_status.
email_confirmation.changed_email: when the current page shows a different address, update email and record the prior value in the audit trail (schema has no previous_email column; keep provenance in the evidence artifact or add one only if a durable in-DB history is required).

moved_or_departed_retention: Never delete a departed coach's identity or evidence. Set currentness_status=PROVEN_STALE with currentness_reason + currentness_source_url + currentness_checked_at. History is preserved; only a genuine DUPLICATE (e.g. the wrong-sport copies) is removed.

currentness_to_eligibility.UNKNOWN: remains eligible (fail-open) but is lower-confidence; surface it for verification before a campaign. Never auto-disqualified.

guardrails.unreachable_page: currentness stays UNKNOWN (never STALE); retry with backoff; try an alternate authoritative source.
guardrails.ambiguous_disappearance: coach absent from a page but departure unconfirmable => UNKNOWN, corroborate with a second source before PROVEN_STALE.
guardrails.coach_seasons: may positively CORROBORATE currency; absence from coach_seasons is NEVER sole negative evidence (assistants are routinely unscraped).
never: extrapolate a prioritized sample rate to the population

stale_check_vs_proven_stale: A currentness_checked_at older than one season means the CHECK is stale (needs re-verification) — not the same as the COACH being PROVEN_STALE.
